verdict.rationale: Mercury exposes a well-documented REST API (accounts, transactions, invoices, webhooks, OAuth2), an official CLI (mercury-cli, verified live and functional), and an AI-agent-friendly llms.txt plus a hosted MCP server with 31 read-only tools — all strong 'build against Mercury' signals. However, there's no evidence of official language SDKs (Python/JS/etc client libraries); the CLI and raw REST API stand in for that, and OpenAPI spec endpoints returned 404, so full SDK support is unconfirmed.
